title: One kernel, different products
method: Archive metadata and full-byte hash comparison
observation: The inspected iPhone and iPod touch 1.1.4/4A102 archives contain a byte-identical kernelcache. Their board trees, bootloaders and primary root images differ.
limits: Shared kernel identity does not establish cross-product userspace, peripheral or telephony compatibility.
